audience: email marketers who report on lists, campaigns and suppressions in Campaigner

useCases.title: Report how a sent campaign performed
useCases.text: List the sent campaigns and open one. Page through its recipient activity, such as opens, clicks, removes and bounces.

useCases.title: Check whether an address is suppressed or bounced
useCases.text: Look up one subscriber by email. Page through a suppression list or the bounces to see whether the address is blocked.

useCases.title: Compare contact list sizes and sign-up sources
useCases.text: List the contact lists with their active member counts. Read the sign-up sources to see where subscribers joined.

useCases.title: Review a subscriber's fields and history
useCases.text: Read one subscriber's custom field values and lists by email. Read the action history of the same subscriber.

useCases.title: Add consenting sign-ups to a contact list
useCases.text: Add up to 100 email addresses to one contact list. Use it only for people who gave consent to email.

useCases.title: Remove contacts from a contact list
useCases.text: Remove up to 100 addresses from one contact list. Those contacts stop getting that list's mail.
